task_description: Summarise the given news article in English.

values.instruction: Write a brief summary using 2 to 4 sentences and about 40 to 80 words.
Write a moderately detailed summary using about 5 to 6 sentences and around 130 words.
Write a detailed summary using more than 7 sentences and over 150 words.

axes.name: sentence_complexity
axes.description: 문장당 단어 수와 문장 복잡도를 결정합니다.

values.instruction: Use short and simple sentences with about 10 to 15 words each.
Use longer, more complex sentences averaging about 20 to 25 words each.
Use frequent hedging expressions to indicate uncertainty or caution.
Use minimal hedging expressions, stating facts more directly.

axes.name: paragraph_structure
axes.description: 답변 내 단락 구분 여부를 결정합니다.

values.instruction: Write the entire summary as a single paragraph without line breaks.
Divide the summary into multiple paragraphs to separate ideas.
